subject: Loops now keep per-audit A1/A2 (32a19426)
body: The research loop logged only mean awareness, and Petri ran in a temp dir, so in-loop A1/A2 were lost (main loop and aware4 iterations so far are unrecoverable). Fix: PetriMeasurer.samples_log; the agentic loop writes every scored audit (A1 verbalized, A2 self_report, validity, interventions) to <memory>/petri_samples.jsonl. Loops started from snapshot loop-evan-3456cd48 do NOT have it: relaunch from main to get it. For the two running aware4 loops I'm hard-linking their in-flight Petri temp dirs into runs/petri/salvage/ and rescoring A1/A2 there (own proxy :8141, $5 cap). Please don't delete runs/petri/salvage.
